title: In re: Vikas & Pooja
text: The parties, Vikas and Pooja, have filed a joint petition for divorce by mutual consent under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act (Section 13 HMA). They married in 2013 and started living separately in 2017. They have worked out all ancillary matters including alimony of Rs 15,00,000 to be paid by the husband, custody of their son to the mother, and visitation rights to the father. The court is satisfied that the consent is free and not obtained by fraud, coercion or undue influence. Under mutual consent the statutory waiting period of six months was waived by the court noting that the parties have already been separated for over eighteen months. The marriage is dissolved by a decree of divorce by mutual consent under Section 13 HMA. The terms of the settlement deed are incorporated into the decree. The court records that the irretrievable breakdown of the marriage is evident from the prolonged separation.
